title: Cough Syrup Testing-Export Sample
bodyHtml:
Refer Government of India vide notification No: 06/2023 dated 22nd May 2023, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Department of Commerce, Directorate General of Foreign Trade, Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi in exercise of power conferred by Section 3 read with section 5 of the foreign trade ( development & regulation) act 1992 (No. 22 of 1992) as amended read with para 1.02 and 2.01 of the foreign trade policy, 2023 central government has authorized Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission, Ghaziabad for testing and production of Certificate of analysis (COA) of COUGH SYRUP sample for Export.

Checklist for Submission of Cough Syrup sample for testing should be ready before making the payment. Once the payment is done kindly submit the below documents along with payment receipt on E-Mail ID: lab.ipc@gov.in
  1. Covering letter from the manufacturer/exporter on letter head addressed to concerned laboratory
  2. Manufacturing license of the product for export purpose
  3. Export order
  4. Representative sample from the export consignment
  5. Thrice the quantity required for performing complete analysis of the sample
  6. Qualitative composition of the product including excipients
  7. Certificate of analysis by the manufacturer of the particular batch and method of analysis (STP)
  8. Reference/working standard (with traceability certificate) and placebo as applicable
  9. Self-declaration on letter head stating non-submission of the same batch number cough syrup sample at different government drug testing lab

Proceed for Online Payment (opens in a new tab)
